name: What should I look for in a contractor for water damaged siding repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for water damaged siding repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for water damaged siding repair in the Bay Area, look for one with specific experience in moisture intrusion and siding repairs. Ensure they are licensed and insured in California. Check for local references and reviews, especially from areas like Pacifica or Daly City, where coastal weather can be a factor. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed quote and explain their process clearly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed, insured contractor with specific experience in water damage and good local references in the Bay Area.
